notes: Visa policy is the single most volatile signal in the entire ontology (see country.json provenance). requires_live_verification=true on this entity means: never let the ranking engine or an LLM state a visa fact to a user without a live re-check against the source URL. Treat cached values here as a directional prior for ranking only, not as travel advice.

entities.name: Thailand entry policy for Indian passport holders
entities.summary: As of the 19 May 2026 Thai Cabinet decision, the unilateral 60-day visa exemption for Indian passports was revoked; entry now routes through e-Visa (apply ahead) or Visa-on-Arrival (15 days, at designated airports). The Royal Thai Embassy New Delhi's public guidance had not been fully reconciled with the Cabinet decision as of last check — this is exactly the kind of conflict that must be live-verified per trip, not answered from cache.

provenance.source: Thai Cabinet decision 19 May 2026 (60-day exemption revoked, India moved to VoA/e-Visa) vs Royal Thai Embassy New Delhi public guidance (exemption described as 'effective until further announcement') — the two sources disagree and neither has been reconciled as of last check
